_readme: Reusable settings for the AI Business Influencer Factory. Edit the values, keep the keys. Never put passwords or API keys in this file - use the .env file instead.

tone: honest about effort and risk - no hype
UK English spelling and pounds sterling
true_facts_about_me: ADD REAL FACTS ONLY, e.g. 'I am learning AI automation in public', 'I have worked in X for Y years'. Scripts may only reference personal experience listed here.

higgsfield._note: Fill these in after the one-time digital twin setup in docs/digital_twin_workflow.md.
higgsfield.lipsync_model_name: Wan 2.7 (start image + your audio, up to 15s per clip)
higgsfield.alt_lipsync_model_name: Seedance 2.5 omni-reference (image + audio references, up to 30s)
higgsfield.start_image_note: A sharp, well-lit, front-facing photo of you at chest height, looking at the camera, plain or tidy background, in the outfit you want on screen.

look.setting: tidy modern home office, bookshelf and plant softly blurred behind
look.wardrobe: plain dark crew-neck t-shirt or overshirt
look.lighting: soft key light from the front-left, gentle rim light, natural skin tones
look.camera: vertical 9:16 medium close-up, chest up, eye-level, phone-camera realism, shallow depth of field
